currentParagraphText: “You have no evidence,” Jake pointed out.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I shall call the Wyrmgod of Nevermore to the stand!” Minaga said with conviction. “The entire encounter was recorded, and I hereby submit this recording into evidence.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “So is murder, but you still killed one of me in Nevermore,” Minaga said in a serious tone. “I should have you prosecuted.”
